headline: See where your time really goes, one task at a time.

highlights.title: Tap play, get to work
highlights.body: Start a task on Today, pause it, pick it up later. ALIBI keeps every session, even if you close the app.

highlights.title: Know where your hours went
highlights.body: Insights now shows your productive time, your biggest tasks, and planned versus actual, for any day, week or month.

highlights.title: Nothing slips past you
highlights.body: Overdue tasks stand out with their original due date, and you can move them to a new day in two taps.

highlights.title: Plans that fit your day
highlights.body: Set when your day starts and ends, and brain dump only suggests times inside it, with clean, spell-checked titles.

notes: Tap play, get to work: start, pause and finish tasks with a timer
Know where your hours went: time insights for any day, week or month
Nothing slips past you: overdue tasks show their original due date
Plans that fit your day: set your day's start and end
